t1.RELEASE_NO: key: newest edition (with RELEASE_DATE) — selects its rows
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows
t1.ROW: key: row order — labels are found by text, not by row number
t1.C01: chart-total — year label and the title block (BASE: … = 100 gives the index base)
t1.C03: skip: revised (R) / provisional (*) mark; the about-the-data list explains provisional data
t1.C04: skip: % change of the trend (the page computes the trend's annualized 3-month change from C05)
t1.C05: chart-total, chart-compare, kpi:ann, insight:trend, insight:gap — trend index
t1.C06: table:total — % change of the seasonally adjusted index on the previous month
t1.C08: skip: % change of the original index on the previous month (seasonal noise; the page compares with the same month a year earlier)
t1.C09: chart-total, chart-yoy, chart-seasons, kpi:yoy, insight:yoy, insight:ytd, insight:annual, insight:season — original index
t1.C10: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C11: skip: revised / provisional mark repeated on the Hebrew side
t1.C12: skip: roman month label repeated on the Hebrew side
t1.C13: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C14: skip: Hebrew titles, footnotes and the year label repeated on the Hebrew side
